Game Functions.title: Game Functions
Game Functions.text1: Below is a table outlining the various buttons present in the game along with explanations of their functions.
Game Functions.text2: Spin button. Press to bet and start the round.
Game Functions.text3: Stop button. Press to stop reels or skip some animations.
Game Functions.text4: Click on the amount to get the entire bet list;
Game Functions.text5: +/- for the quick switching between bets.
Game Functions.text9: Number of Rounds - number of automatic bets.
Game Functions.text10: Loss Limit - stops autoplay if the player's Balance decreases by the specified amount (or more). The difference is calculated relative to the start of the autoplay mode.
Game Functions.text11: Single Win Limit - stops autoplay when the player's winnings are greater than or equal to the specified amount.
Game Functions.text12: When autoplay rounds are active, this button displays the remaining number of rounds. Clicking this button stops the autoplay mode.
Game Functions.text13: Select to access game settings and information.
Game Functions.text20: Click to view the Game Rules.
Game Functions.text21: Click to go back to the game.
Game Functions.text22: Select to open the Buy Free Spins window, where you can instantly purchase the specified number of Free Spins at the displayed price.

Win Ways.title: Win Ways
Win Ways.text1: A Win Ways win occurs when identical symbols land on consecutive reels starting from the leftmost reel.

Cluster Pays.title: Cluster Pays
Cluster Pays.text1: A Cluster Pays win occurs when {{minClusterSize}} or more identical symbols are connected vertically and/or horizontally.

Paylines.title: Paylines
Paylines.text1: Symbols pay from left to right on adjacent reels starting from the leftmost reel.
Paylines.text2: Only the highest winning combination is paid per line.
